MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING

Between Northfield Arts and Opal Museum on a joint exhibition.

The parties will share exhibition costs equally and carry their own insurance. Liability of each party is limited to its own costs.

Signed. Signature: Zoe Lane. Signature: Cal Reed.

expected.rationale: Benign cost-sharing terms with liability limited to each party's own costs. No ownership triggers; signed.
